title: OpenCode chart fence
description: Body of a ```chart fenced block. A JSON object; one chart per block. 'type' is strongly recommended: when it is missing the shape of the data decides (slices -> pie, columns+rows -> table, rows -> heatmap, values/series -> bar). Unknown keys are ignored, and the renderer prints a muted footer when it had to rename a key, treat a value as 0, or guess the type.

width.description: Chart columns. Clamped to the available terminal content width.

height.description: Total rows for the chart, including title, labels, legend and notes. A plot-only family takes plotHeight for the plot area.

plotHeight.description: Rows for the plot area. Overrides the plot part of height; the chrome (title, labels, legend, notes) sits outside it.

theme.description: Colour set. Defaults to the terminal theme.

mosaic.description: Sub-cell glyph set. Default sextant (Unicode 13); octant is finer but Unicode 16, so only use it when the font is known to carry it.

cellAspect.description: A cell's height over its width, for the round families (pie, radar). Default 2; a font that draws them tall wants about 2.3.

legend.description: Show the series legend. Default true.

labels.description: Category names or axis names, in data order.

name.description: Name of the single series built from values. A series item carries its own name.

items.description: Candles as [open, high, low, close] per period.

values.description: The numbers, one array or one array per series. A nested [open, high, low, close] row is candle data.

type.description: Combo only: how this series is drawn. Defaults to a line.

series.description: Named series, [{name, values}]. Wins over values.

slices.description: Pie and donut data, as [label, value] pairs.

stacked.description: Bars and areas: series stack instead of grouping.

normalized.description: Bars and areas: 100% of each label's total. The legend still prints the real totals.

showPercent.description: Single-series bars: print the share beside each value. (The old name 'percent' is accepted and renamed with a note.)

boundaryColor.description: Colour of the seam between two series. Defaults to the theme background. (The old name 'gap' is accepted and renamed with a note.)

zero.description: Line, area, scatter and candle: set false for a narrow range so the data fills the plot. Bars always include zero.

ticks.description: Axis charts (bar, histogram, line, candle, ohlc, waterfall): how many labelled ticks to aim for. Default 4.

textured.description: Bars and pie: a hatch pattern per series, for monochrome terminals.

bins.description: Histogram: bin count, clamped to 60. Default is the square-root rule, capped at 30.

data.description: Histogram: the samples, as alias for values, the canonical key.

start.description: Waterfall: the running total before the first delta.

total.description: Waterfall: draw the closing total bar.

totalLabel.description: Waterfall: name of the total bar.

totalColor.description: Waterfall: colour of the closing total bar. Defaults to the first palette colour.

up.description: Candles and waterfall: colour of an upward move.

down.description: Candles and waterfall: colour of a downward move.

candles.description: Candle data as {open, high, low, close} objects, instead of nested values.

dates.description: Calendar: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), parallel to `values`. The grid spans the first to the last date.

targets.description: Bullet: the target per item, parallel to `values`. Drawn as a tick over the bar.

ranges.description: Bullet: qualitative bands as [low, high] pairs, darkest first, up to three.

headers.description: Heat map columns. (The old name 'columns' is accepted and renamed with a note.)

rows.description: Heat map: rows as {label, values}. Table: rows as arrays in column order.

cellWidth.description: Heat map: columns per cell. Defaults to the widest header plus one.

low.description: Heat map and table heat columns: colour for the lowest value.

high.description: Heat map and table heat columns: colour for the highest value.

from.description: Heat map: alias for low, the canonical key for the ramp's low end.

to.description: Heat map: alias for high, the canonical key for the ramp's high end.

min.description: The bottom of the scale: heat map, and gantt day offsets. Default is the smallest value drawn.

scale.description: Heat map: print the colour scale row. Default true.

valueLabels.description: Heat map, bars, line and waterfall: print each value.

columns.description: Table: column definitions. Each entry is a name or {label, key, type, width, color, align}.

rules.description: Table: rule under the header. Default true.

items.description: Treemap: leaves as {label, value}, groups as {label, children}.

children.description: Treemap: alias for items, the canonical key.

nodes.description: Sankey: named nodes, with an optional column to pin the layer.

links.description: Sankey: flows as {from, to, value} between node ids.

items.description: Kanban: flat cards; the column is decided by 'column', 'status' or 'list'.

cards.description: Kanban: a flat card list, when the columns are not declared inline.

columnWidth.description: Kanban: width of one column in cells. Default is what the width budget allows.

titleLines.description: Kanban: lines a card title may wrap to. Default 3.

metaLines.description: Kanban: lines a card's meta may wrap to. Default 2; 0 hides it.

max.description: The top of the scale: heat map, gantt, radar and gauge. Default is the largest value drawn, so set it on both charts to share a scale.

filled.description: Radar: fill the polygon even with several series.

axes.description: Radar: alias for labels, the canonical key.

spokes.description: Radar and pie: draw the axis lines.

target.description: Gauge and progress: a marker on the track.

track.description: Horizontal bars: show the unfilled track.

slotLabels.description: Bars: give every bar its own label slot. Default true; false centres each label on its bar, which suits long labels.

horizontal.description: Bars: draw horizontal bars. The same as type hbar.

big.description: Scatter: double the marker so single points stay visible.

donut.description: Pie and donut: draw a hole in the middle. The same as type donut.

margin.description: Pie and donut: blank columns around the disc. Default 1.

glyphs.description: Pie and donut: one fill glyph per slice, for monochrome terminals.

plainLegend.description: Pie and donut: print the legend as text rows instead of marker cells.

value.description: Gauge and progress: the value the bar shows. Default 0.

label.description: Gauge and progress: the name printed beside the bar.

tasks.description: Gantt rows as {label, group, start, end}, or {label, at} for a milestone. start and end take ISO dates or plain numbers; start also answers to from, end to to or finish, at to date.

today.description: Gantt: where the today marker sits, as an ISO date or a day offset. false hides it.

todayColor.description: Gantt: colour of the today marker. Defaults to the fourth palette colour.

note.description: Histogram: print the sample count and bin width under the chart.
